claim: Cached entries dispatch without prioritizing expensive validation.
evidence: Ordering alone did not improve the two 24-round experiments. Sorting plus four macOS workers improved warm medians by 3.5–5.5 ms in the confirmation experiment. Final code limits four workers to standalone all-hit batches; explicit overrides win. Three 100-sample cohorts confirm combined gains with freshness and lock-snapshot changes. Cold controls and independent CI-cold confirmation are recorded in the report.
